simple.prompt: Nominalizing the verb 'assess': 'The committee carried out a thorough ___ of the environmental impact.'
simple.explanation: Kata kerja 'assess' dinominalisasi menjadi kata benda 'assessment' ('carry out an assessment').

simple.prompt: Nominalizing 'decide': 'Their prompt ___ prevented further escalation of the crisis.'
Susun kalimat nominalisasi dari 'The team investigated'.
simple.targetSentence: An investigation was conducted by the forensic team.
simple.explanation: An investigation (noun) + was conducted + by the forensic team.
hints: Mulai dengan nomina: 'An investigation was conducted'.

simple.prompt: Nominalizing 'destroy': 'The hurricane caused catastrophic ___ across the coastal towns.'
Susun kalimat nominalisasi dengan 'The discovery of'.
simple.targetSentence: The discovery of penicillin revolutionized modern medicine.
simple.explanation: The discovery of penicillin + revolutionized modern medicine.
hints: Mulai dengan frasa nomina: 'The discovery of penicillin'.

simple.prompt: Nominalizing 'expand': 'The company announced a major global ___ plan.'
Susun kalimat nominalisasi dengan 'The implementation of'.
simple.targetSentence: The implementation of the new policy took several months.
simple.explanation: The implementation of the new policy + took several months.
hints: Mulai dengan subjek nomina: 'The implementation of the new policy'.

intermediate.prompt: Lengkapi dialog pergeseran register verbal ke nominal.
dialogue: When temperatures rose, the Arctic ice melted more rapidly.
The ___ in temperature led to accelerated ice melt.
intermediate.explanation: Verba 'temperatures rose' dipadatkan secara akademis menjadi 'The rise in temperature...'.
hints: Bentuk kata benda dari verba rise.

intermediate.prompt: Transforming adjectives into abstract nouns: 'He was resilient' -> 'His ___ under pressure was commendable.'
hints: Bentuk kata benda abstrak dari resilient.

intermediate.prompt: Academic compression: 'Because the government failed to intervene...' becomes 'The government's ___ led to widespread panic.'
intermediate.explanation: Klausa 'failed to intervene' dipadatkan menjadi noun phrase elegan: 'The government's failure to intervene'.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat pemadatan akademik dari 'they were absent'.
intermediate.targetSentence: Frequent employee absence significantly lowered quarterly productivity.
intermediate.explanation: Frequent employee absence (noun phrase) + significantly lowered quarterly productivity.

intermediate.prompt: Turning complex actions into grammatical subjects: 'We need to eradicate poverty' -> 'The ___ of poverty is our foremost mandate.'
Susun kalimat akademik dengan subjek nominal 'The rapid proliferation'.
intermediate.targetSentence: The rapid proliferation of digital smartphones transformed human communication.
intermediate.explanation: The rapid proliferation of digital smartphones + transformed human communication.
hints: Mulai dengan nomina: 'The rapid proliferation of digital smartphones'.

dialogue: We observed how birds migrate in autumn.
Let's entitle the paper: '___ of Autumn Avian Migration Patterns'.
intermediate.explanation: Judul akademik baku mengutamakan bentuk nominal murni: 'Observations of...'.
hints: Bentuk kata benda jamak formal untuk judul riset.

complex.prompt: Koreksi kalimat yang menderita 'heavy nominalization' (zombie nouns yang membuat tulisan kaku dan sulit dipahami).
complex.draft: The commencement of the operationalization of the strategy will be made by management.
options: Management will begin operationalizing the strategy.
The operationalization of strategy will have commencement.
There will be a commencement by management to operationalize.
complex.explanation: Nominalisasi berlebihan (zombie nouns seperti 'commencement of the operationalization') merusak kejelasan. Penulisan yang baik mengembalikan kata kerja aktif: 'Management will begin operationalizing the strategy'.
hints: Kembalikan kata kerja aktif yang lincah dan jelas.
Pilih 'Management will begin operationalizing the strategy'.

complex.prompt: Syntactic role of nominalization in academic writing:
options: It packages entire complex processes into thematic 'things' (noun concepts) that can be commented on, evaluated, or linked as grammatical subjects.
It is a decorative technique with no linguistic function.
It is only used when the author does not know the subject.
complex.explanation: Nominalisasi mengemas proses dinamis (verba) menjadi entitas statis (nomina) yang kemudian dapat dijadikan subjek gramatikal untuk dianalisis lebih lanjut (information packaging).
hints: Fungsi pengemasan proses menjadi konsep tematik (thematic packaging).
Pilih opsi packages entire complex processes into thematic things.

complex.prompt: Select the sentence illustrating sophisticated lexical nominalization of causal relationships:
options: Urbanization triggered the depletion of local groundwater reserves.
People moved to cities and so they used up all the water underground.
Because people lived in urban places, water went away.
complex.explanation: Kausalitas informal ('people moved to cities and so...') diubah menjadi struktur nominal padat: 'Urbanization (subjek) triggered the depletion of local groundwater reserves (objek nominal)'.
hints: Gaya tulisan ilmiah dengan kepadatan leksikal tinggi.
Pilih opsi dengan 'Urbanization triggered the depletion'.

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat ilmiah padat dengan nominalisasi sebab-akibat.
complex.targetSentence: Deforestation contributed to the destabilization of local microclimates.
complex.explanation: Deforestation (noun) + contributed to + the destabilization of local microclimates (noun phrase).
hints: Predikat dan objek: 'contributed to the destabilization of local microclimates'.

complex.draft: The analyze of the quantitative data demonstrated high statistical reliability.
options: The analysis of the quantitative data demonstrated high statistical reliability.
The analyzing of the quantitative data demonstrated reliability.
The analytical of the quantitative data demonstrated reliability.
complex.explanation: Bentuk kata benda yang tepat dari kata kerja 'analyze' adalah 'analysis' (bukan analyze/analyzement).

complex.prompt: When does an expert editor recommend unpacking nominalizations back into active verbs?
options: When abstract nouns pile up and obscure who did what to whom, resulting in sluggish prose.
Whenever a sentence has more than five words.
Never; all academic sentences must consist solely of nouns.
complex.explanation: Jika tumpukan kata benda abstrak mengaburkan pelaku dan alur aksi, editor merekomendasikan untuk membongkar nomina tersebut kembali ke kata kerja aktif yang lugas.
hints: Ketika teks menjadi kaku dan mengaburkan pelaku serta tindakan.
Pilih opsi obscure who did what to whom.

dialogue: Why is 'The intensification of hostilities precipitated diplomatic collapse' preferred in scholarly articles?
Because it encapsulates two complex historical events into ___.
complex.explanation: Nominalisasi memadatkan dua peristiwa bersejarah yang kompleks menjadi satu rantai kausal SVO yang padat dan presisi.
hints: Memadatkan peristiwa ke dalam rantai kausal SVO ringkas.
